about: explanatory scientific prose; evidence and meaning take priority over diagnostics.

caps.label: must
caps.fix: Use for an actual logical or methodological necessity; avoid repeated prescriptions.

caps.label: inference connectors
caps.fix: Keep a connector when the inference needs it; avoid repeated automatic transitions.

caps.label: dash asides
caps.fix: Integrate the qualification or use ordinary punctuation.

banned.label: delve
banned.fix: Use the specific action: analyze, compare, estimate or test.

banned.label: empty praise
banned.fix: State the supported novelty or comparison with its scope.

banned.label: empty emphasis
banned.pattern: \b(?:it is worth noting that|needless to say|plays a pivotal role|underscores the importance of)\b
banned.fix: State the object and supported claim directly.

banned.label: generic promise
banned.pattern: \b(?:paves? the way|opens? new avenues|unlocks? the potential|expand(?:s)? the horizons)\b
banned.fix: Name the specific implication and what remains untested.

banned_openers.label: vague paratext
banned_openers.fix: State the finding, question or concrete scope.

advisory.label: blanket importance
advisory.fix: Check context: statistical significance and domain-specific technical meanings are legitimate.

manual: Assess clarity, logical qualification and paragraph purpose in context.
Preserve measured conditions, uncertainty and necessary technical terms.

rhythm.about: A paragraph of min_sentences or more whose sentence lengths all fall within max_range words (English) or max_range_zh characters (Chinese) is flagged as uniform-rhythm. check_manuscript.py warns when explanation connectives (so, because, since, then, therefore, thus, hence; 因此、从而、进而一类) exceed max_connectives_per_100 per 100 sentences in either language; aim for about 8.
rhythm.fix: let the content set the length: a long sentence for a mechanism with its conditions, a short one for a plain result

zh.about: Checks for Chinese paragraphs (prose_lint.py). Template phrases are weight 2; the connective, ordinal and question checks follow the English line-of-thought rules.

connective.label: zh explanation connective
connective.pattern: 因此|从而|进而|所以|由此|于是|因而|故而
connective.fix: 因果主要由句序和具名的研究者承担，只在读者会漏掉关系的地方保留连接词

zh.question: [？?]$|^(如何|为何|为什么|是否|哪些|什么|怎样|能否)
zh.question_fix: 不用设问和内嵌问句，直接写出结论或依赖关系
zh.ordinal_fix: 并列内容没有先后时，按区分各组的依据命名各组

template.label: 值得注意的是
template.pattern: 值得(注意|一提|关注|指出)的是

template.label: 综上所述
template.pattern: 综上所述|总而言之|总的来说|总之，
template.fix: 删去总结语，结论写成带依据和范围的陈述

template.label: 提供了新思路
template.pattern: 提供了?(一种|一条)?(新的?|全新的?)(思路|途径|视角|可能|方向)
template.fix: 写出具体做到了什么、在什么条件下

template.label: 奠定了基础
template.pattern: 奠定了?(坚实的?|重要的?|良好的?)?基础
template.fix: 写出下一步具体可以做什么

template.label: 发挥着重要作用
template.pattern: (发挥|起)着?(重要|关键|至关重要|核心)的?作用|扮演着?(重要|关键|核心)的?角色

template.label: 引起了广泛关注
template.pattern: (引起|受到|吸引)了?(广泛|大量|越来越多|极大)的?(关注|兴趣|重视)
template.fix: 删去，或写出具体的研究进展

template.label: 具有重要意义
template.pattern: 具有(重要|深远|重大|广泛)的?(意义|价值)|(广阔|巨大|良好)的?应用前景
template.fix: 写出具体的用途和条件

template.label: 随着……的发展
template.pattern: 随着.{1,20}的(快速|迅速|飞速|不断|蓬勃)?发展
template.fix: 从具体的问题或事实开头

template.label: 为……提供了有力支撑
template.pattern: 提供了?(有力|坚实|重要)的?(支撑|支持|保障)
